pages.h1: Writesonic vs Jasper (2026): Which AI Writing Tool Is Better?
pages.metaDescription: Writesonic vs Jasper compared on verified 2026 data: pricing (from $79/mo vs from $59/mo), affiliate commissions (20% x 12 months vs 25% recurring), plans and features. Checked 2026-08-07.

verdict.winner: Depends on budget and commission structure - Jasper leads on starting price and open-ended recurring commission; Writesonic leads on plan range and a defined 12-month window.
verdict.why: On verified data (2026-08-07), Jasper is cheaper to start ($59/mo vs $79/mo, both annual billing) and pays 25% recurring commissions on Creator and Teams plans with no stated end date. Writesonic pays 20% recurring but only for 12 months, and its plans run to $399/mo. Neither tool had a named-source rating verified at publish time, so this comparison is price and commission data only.
verdict.bestForA: Writesonic: content teams that want a broad plan range (Swipe Starter to Growth) and a clearly defined 12-month recurring commission window.
verdict.bestForB: Jasper: teams that want a lower starting price and open-ended 25% recurring commissions on Creator/Teams plans.

faqs.question: Which is better, Writesonic or Jasper?
faqs.answer: Based on verified price and commission data (2026-08-07), Jasper starts lower ($59/mo vs $79/mo annual) and pays a higher recurring commission (25% vs 20%) with no stated end date. Writesonic has the wider plan range (up to $399/mo) and a defined 12-month commission window. Neither rating was verified at publish time.

faqs.question: Which pays higher affiliate commissions, Writesonic or Jasper?
faqs.answer: Jasper: 25% recurring on Creator and Teams plans (Business excluded). Writesonic: 20% recurring for 12 months. Both verified on official pages on 2026-08-07.

faqs.question: Does Writesonic or Jasper have a free plan?
faqs.answer: Not stated in the pricing data verified on 2026-08-07. Both tools list paid plans from $79/mo and $59/mo respectively.
